eventPage.title: African Tourism University
eventPage.venue: Sofitel Hôtel Ivoire, Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire
eventPage.intro: The 1st African Tourism University is a landmark event bringing together key players in African tourism: public institutions, private operators, investors, and international experts. This intensive day aims to lay the foundations for a sustainable, competitive, and inclusive African tourism industry.
eventPage.rectorRole: Former Minister of Tourism and Leisure, Côte d'Ivoire
eventPage.rectorBio: The architect of the 'Sublime Côte d'Ivoire' strategy, Mr. Fofana is an emblematic figure in tourism development in West Africa. His patronage gives this event significant institutional standing.
eventPage.registerCta: Register for the 1st African Tourism University

about.title: The University of High-Performance Organisations
about.subtitle: Strengthening the capacities of executives, managers, and leaders.
about.missionText1: ETHSUN Institute supports professionals, managers, and executives in developing their skills through internationally certified programmes. We believe that professional training is the most powerful lever for transforming organisations and African economies.
about.missionText2: Our programmes are designed by practitioner experts, grounded in African realities, and enriched by international best practices.
about.visionText: To become a reference academic institution, radiating internationally from our Learning Centers around the world.
about.founderBio: Driven by the deep conviction that human capital is the primary lever of sustainable transformation, Jean-Calvin ETHIEN, CEO of ETHSUN Institute, is actively committed to skills development across Africa and internationally. Through a structured, demanding, and impact-oriented approach, he works to design training systems capable of strengthening individual capacities, supporting organisational performance, and preparing a new generation of leaders ready to meet today's economic, institutional, and technological challenges.
about.ecosystemSubtitle: ETHSUN is built on a structured ecosystem of complementary pillars, designed to address the contemporary challenges of training, governance, and organisational performance.
about.licenceNote: under licence from ETHSUN Executive Education Oxford — Per Doctrinam Excelsior

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content:
ETHSUN Institute is committed to protecting the privacy of its users and to processing their personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of the European Union and applicable Ivorian law.

This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our website or interact with our services.

controller.title: 2. Data controller
controller.content:
The data controller for your personal data is:
ETHSUN Institute
Cocody 2 Plateaux Vallon, Rue J — Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire
Email: info@ethsun-institute.com
Phone: (+225) 05 45 61 30 35

dataCollected.title: 3. Data collected
dataCollected.content:
We collect the following personal data:
• Identification data: first name, surname
• Contact details: email address, phone number
• Professional data: job title, organisation, sector
• Data relating to your interest in our programmes: selected programme, message
• Browsing data: IP address, technical cookies, connection data

This data is collected when you complete our contact form, register for a programme or event, or browse our website.

purposes.title: 4. Purposes of processing
purposes.content:
Your personal data is collected for the following purposes:
• Responding to your enquiries about our training programmes
• Managing your registrations for our programmes and events
• Sending you information about our programmes, news, and events (with your consent)
• Improving the quality of our services and website
• Complying with our legal and regulatory obligations

legalBasis.title: 5. Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.content:
The processing of your data is based on:
• Your explicit consent (for marketing communications)
• The performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures (for managing registrations)
• Our legitimate interests (for improving our services)
• Compliance with our legal obligations

retention.title: 6. Retention period
retention.content:
Your personal data is retained for the period strictly necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected:
• Contact and registration data: 3 years from the last contact
• Billing data: 10 years (accounting obligations)
• Browsing data (cookies): maximum 13 months

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.content:
Under applicable regulations, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
• Right of access: obtain a copy of your data
• Right of rectification: correct inaccurate data
• Right to erasure: request deletion of your data
• Right to restriction of processing
• Right to object to processing
• Right to data portability

To exercise these rights, please contact us at: info@ethsun-institute.com

security.title: 8. Data security
security.content: ETHSUN Institute implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Our website uses HTTPS protocol to secure data exchanges.

thirdParties.title: 9. Sharing data with third parties
thirdParties.content:
Your data is not sold to third parties. It may be shared with:
• Our technical service providers (Vercel hosting, Brevo emailing tools) strictly within the scope of their services
• Competent authorities where required by law

These providers are subject to confidentiality obligations and may only use your data for the purposes for which it was communicated to them.

contact.title: 10. Contact and complaints
contact.content:
For any questions regarding this privacy policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us:
Email: info@ethsun-institute.com
Address: ETHSUN Institute — Cocody 2 Plateaux Vallon, Rue J, Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire

If you believe your rights have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.
